title: Anti-drone technology fails at PSEG Salem/Hope Creek
place_text: Hope Creek Generating Station, Salem County, New Jersey

tellings.quote: they tried to deploy an anti-drone technology over multiple drones that were seen over the nuclear site and that anti- drone Dr technology which normally works on all drones completely failed

plain: In 2024, several drones were reportedly seen over the Salem and Hope Creek nuclear power station in Salem County, New Jersey. Staff are said to have turned anti-drone technology on them, and it failed completely, though it normally works on all drones. The researcher Robert Hastings, who studies UFOs at nuclear sites, tells Michels he heard this from someone with access to the station's internal messages, and he tells it because it would mean the objects were not ordinary drones.
